data.name: Scarshield
data.description: A scarred witch doctor learns how to harden her mutilated skin, gaining an enhancement bonus to her natural armor bonus equal to %1. She can use this ability for %2 minutes per day. These minutes do not need to be consecutive but she must spend them in 1-minute increments. This ability replaces the witch's 1st-level hex.|ScarredWitchNaturalArmorBonus|ScarredWithDoctorNaturalArmorDuration
